scope: DAT v56 lightmap axes, polygon extents and trailing lightmap block; texel origin rule; Saturate composition; atlas pages and shader sampling. No renderer, preprocessor or game code imported

retail_evidence.purpose: Shipped "Saturate" "1" default selecting the doubled lightmap modulation.
High detail enables "LightMap" 1 (and MaxModelShadows 1 for later work).
Strings only: Saturate, LightSaturate, LightMap and 1/2-pass lightmapping. No code is executed or disassembled.
Block location, entry sizes, origin rule and orientation validated on every model of the 57 readable worlds; RGB565 hue and vertex-color correlation.

references.purpose: Later-generation FindTextureOrigin/AdjustForVec grid snapping and CalculateTextureSize, the basis of the origin rule; Blood II differs on grid lines and in using the non-unit axes.
Later-generation lightmap texel coordinate P.(v - O) / grid + 0.5.
Later-generation principal-plane lightmap basis (N x axis), matching the non-unit stored axes.
Later-generation pass order (lightmap, dynamic lights, texture multiply) and Saturate SRCCOLOR blend.
Saturate MODULATE2X is limited to lightmap and fullbright shaders; plain Gouraud stays unscaled.
Later-generation RLE RGB888 storage, consulted to confirm Blood II's uncompressed RGB565 entries differ.

adaptations: The lightmap block is located by exact length and accepted only when one offset validates; the preceding grid/cell data stays opaque.
The origin on a grid line is chosen by the stored texel count among the snapped line and its neighbors, replacing the unknown original float evaluation.
Lightmaps are packed into 1024x1024 RGBA8 atlas pages with replicated borders and sampled bilinearly; the original paged per-surface textures differently.
